notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ زُرَارَةُ» — the one asked is only a pronoun: the Imam comes from prev1 (2372), which names him in its words («سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ»), not in its written chain («عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ»)
the asker زرارة comes first and the Imam is the last link (rule 5, example 6)
